words.trans: n. 极度兴奋；狂喜；畅快激动
examples: He was tight with fear, not laughing in exhilaration as before.
The climbers shouted with exhilaration when they reached the summit.

words.trans: 船头护栏；船头栏杆
examples: Tom was leaning over the bow rails of the Teal.
Passengers gripped the bow rails as the ship cut through the rough sea.

words.trans: 固定文学习语，复数名词短语。字面指关节发白，引申义高度紧张、提心吊胆
examples: He grabbed the cold metal of the railings with white knuckles.
She held the armrest with white knuckles during the turbulent landing.

words.trans: 快速大幅度转动舵轮，不是慢慢微调，是一把一把猛打方向
examples: Rufus Clay was on the bridge, spinning the wheel like a madman.
The old sailor began to spin the wheel to turn the boat around.

words.trans: n. 大浅盘；大餐盘，常常是椭圆形（尤其装鱼）
examples: Snakey was presenting the Queen with a huge fish on a platter.
The turkey was served on a large silver platter.

words.trans: adj. 嗓音沙哑的，嘶哑的
examples: His voice was a hoarse whisper that was whipped away by the wind.
After shouting all night, his voice had gone hoarse.

words.trans: n. 钢锯；弓锯（用来锯金属的手锯）
examples: On another bench there was a couple of hacksaws.
He used a hacksaw to cut through the metal pipe.

words.trans: n. 喷灯；焊枪
examples: On the bench lay a blowtorch and a scattering of syringes.
The plumber used a blowtorch to join the copper pipes.

words.trans: n. 注射器；针筒
examples: There were a couple of hacksaws and a scattering of syringes.
The nurse filled a syringe with the vaccine.

words.trans: adj. 哑光的，无光泽的，不反光的（英式拼写；美式常写 matte）
examples: Each drone had been painted a matt grey.
Choose a matt finish for the wall so it doesn't glare.

words.trans: 哑光灰/磨砂灰
examples: Each drone had been painted a matt grey to avoid reflection.
The military vehicle was coated in matt gray paint.

words.trans: n. 鼻孔（nostril 的复数）
examples: Maggie's nostrils flared at the smell.
The horse flared its nostrils and snorted.

words.trans: v. 用东西顶住、撑住，使保持某个状态
examples: She propped the door open with a fire extinguisher.
He propped his bicycle against the wall.

words.trans: v. 瘫倒、颓然倒下；无力地歪倒
examples: She pulled a dart out and the bear slumped on its side, as if dead.
He slumped into the chair, exhausted after the marathon.

words.trans: n.（容器的）密封塞、橡胶堵头（rubber bung 橡胶塞、橡胶堵头）
examples: A hollow needle was stuck into a rubber bung.
He pulled the rubber bung out of the bucket to drain the water.

words.word: run a hand through one's hair
words.trans: 手插入发丝，向后捋一遍头发，指尖穿行在头发之间
words.key: run a hand through one's hair
examples: Tom swung his legs over the sofa and ran a hand through his hair.
He nervously ran a hand through his hair before answering.

words.trans: n. 内行，专业老手（pro 的复数形式，口语简写）
examples: The people we are dealing with are pros, not schoolboys.
Don't worry — they're pros and know exactly what to do.

words.trans: 乖乖跟人走，不反抗、不挣扎、不大吵大闹
examples: What if they don't come quietly when we turn up?
The suspect was told to come quietly or be arrested by force.

words.trans: 所有备选方案里最后、最狠、代价最大、破坏性最强的一招；孤注一掷的终极方案
examples: So you think we need a 'nuclear option'?
Firing everyone was seen as the nuclear option of management.

words.trans: adj. 锯短的
examples: A cluster of metal tubes, like sawn-off shotguns, had sprouted from the machine.
He carried a sawn-off shotgun under his coat.

words.trans: n. 霰弹枪，猎枪
examples: A cluster of metal tubes like sawn-off shotguns.
The farmer kept a shotgun to scare off foxes.

words.trans: 一夜之间就冒了出来
examples: Metal tubes had sprouted overnight from the centre of the machine.
New coffee shops seem to sprout overnight in this district.

words.trans: adj. 气动的；由压缩空气驱动的
examples: There was a pneumatic hiss, like a sharp intake of breath.
The factory uses pneumatic tools to drill the metal.

words.trans: adv. 令人恶心地；让人心里发慌、反胃地；叫人不适地
examples: The weapon was sickeningly quiet.
The room fell into a sickeningly familiar silence.

words.trans: adv. 严肃地；郑重地；一本正经地
examples: The others watched him solemnly as he shut the drone down.
He solemnly promised that he would return by nightfall.

words.trans: adv. 无辜地；若无其事地；一副毫无危险的样子
examples: Two other drones, each parked innocently in front of its monitor.
The child looked up innocently and asked, 'Who, me?'

words.trans: 我们时间不够；留给我们的时间不多了
examples: Listen carefully, because we don't have long.
Hurry — we don't have long before the shop closes.

words.trans: v. 协调；统筹，同步安排
examples: We have to coordinate our attack exactly.
The volunteers coordinated the rescue effort across the valley.

words.trans: 麻烦/棘手的环节。bit 在英式口语里常代替 part，表示事情中的某一部分、某一环节；part 英美通用，用 bit 英式口语味更浓
examples: We have to coordinate our attack exactly, and that's the tricky bit.
Getting it started is easy; keeping it running is the tricky bit.

words.trans: 字面掠过、扫过，多用于描写情绪、光影、神色在人脸上一闪而过
examples: A flicker of doubt passed across her face.
A shadow of sadness passed across his eyes.

words.trans: 一丝疑虑
examples: But a flicker of doubt passed across her face.
For a moment a flicker of doubt crossed his mind.

words.trans: n. 弹药、发射弹（这里指飞镖弹药，不是“四轮”）
examples: There are four rounds on each drone.
The soldier loaded a few extra rounds into his rifle.

words.trans: adj. 速效的，起效很快的
examples: One shot will administer a dose of a fast-acting anaesthetic.
Keep a fast-acting painkiller in the first-aid kit.

words.trans: n. 麻醉剂
examples: A dose of a fast-acting anaesthetic.
The dentist gave him a local anaesthetic before pulling the tooth.

words.trans: （医药/麻醉固定短语）使某人失去意识、麻醉放倒、弄晕
examples: The anaesthetic will put the terrorists out for just long enough.
The gas was strong enough to put the whole household out.

words.trans: 驶离（危险）射程范围
examples: It will put them out long enough for the Teal to sail out of range.
The ship increased speed to sail out of range of the shore guns.

words.trans: 顶天二十分钟/最多二十分钟。tops 放在数量后，口语非正式用法表示上限，暗示实际很可能还用不到这么久，等于 at maximum
examples: Twenty minutes tops for the hexacopters.
The walk should take ten minutes tops.

words.trans: 尚未发生、有待发生、还没有做（sth be yet to do = sth has not happened yet，如 The worst was yet to come.）
examples: He knew the worst was yet to come.
The full consequences of the decision are yet to be seen.

words.trans: n. 口语俚语：电量、能源、动力
examples: There won't be enough juice to get the drones back home.
My phone is dead — it's completely out of juice.

words.trans: v.（医药场景）施用；给药，注入（药剂）。强调规范地、可控地施用、投放药剂
examples: One shot will administer a dose of anaesthetic.
The nurse administered the injection very slowly.

words.trans: n. 丙泊酚（异丙酚），医院手术室用的短效静脉全身麻醉药
examples: Propofol would do the job as an emergency anaesthetic.
The patient was kept under with a steady drip of propofol.

words.word: hold out one's palms in refusal
words.trans: 字面摊开、伸出两只手掌。动作画面：双臂微抬，手掌朝前摊开，是英语文化里摆手拒绝、叫停、别再说了的肢体姿态
words.key: hold out one's palms in refusal
examples: Maggie held out her palms in refusal.
He held up both hands in refusal and backed away.

words.trans: n. 俯冲；急转直下，暴跌  v. 机头朝下猛冲、急剧下坠；（数值、局势）快速恶化
examples: Then we'll nosedive all three drones into the water.
The plane seemed to nosedive straight towards the ground.
